metadata.description: Curated subset of the FP8 engine-factorial experiment (Qwen3-8B, iteration-4 random plan-site pushes re-run under W8A8 / W8A16 / W16A8 / bf16 numerics) for code_demo.ipynb.

selection.slots: every CRN slot of each direction: screen k 0-1 and confirmation k 2-5 x templates W1-W5 (confirmation slots exist only for engines whose screen passed)

engines.a: W8A8: e4m3 weights (per output channel) x e4m3 activations (per token); iteration-4 engine
engines.b: W8A16: the same e4m3 weights x bf16 activations (weight rounding only)
engines.c: W16A8: bf16 weights x per-token e4m3 fake-quantised activations (activation rounding only)
engines.d: BF16: bf16 weights x bf16 activations (full-precision reference)

metadata.row_format: predict_<engine> = '<algorithm label>|<pass or fail on the hidden tests>' for the program that engine generated in this CRN slot; a missing predict_<engine> means that engine did not run the slot

feasibility_reading.rule: E(c)-E(d) >= (2/3)(E(a)-E(d)) and one-sided exact McNemar c>d p<0.05

T10|b-d|confirmed.status: confirmation incomplete for an engine; see screen level

T10|a-b|confirmed.status: confirmation incomplete for an engine; see screen level
